title: Chapter 515
text:
The more Han Xiao listened, the more confused he became. "What do you mean? Wasn't it Godora who asked you to do this?"

Kedan was stunned for a moment and realized that this group of people had misunderstood something. He hesitated, but then he remembered that the other party had the ability to detect lies. His face turned pale, and he said softly, "No, this has nothing to do with Godora. This is my personal plan."

Hannes and Bennett, who were filled with righteous indignation, were suddenly stunned.

"I have such authority in my hands, and my daily work is too boring. One day, when I saw the situation of the Blue Star Civilization, I suddenly thought of using the Blue Star Civilization as a sandbox and playing with this planet. After all, it is a native civilization, and it is very easy to fool them. Furthermore, there is no risk … Because the upper echelons do not care about the internal conflicts of low-level civilizations, I wanted to start a war and watch you guys fight because of it. I felt that this would be very interesting … I thought of it, so I did it.

"Angelo cooperated with me, but he chose to stay in Blue Star. He felt that returning to Godora would be meaningless, so he would rather stay on a native planet and personally witness the effects that he had caused on this planet. He felt that this matter was very interesting."

After Kedan finished speaking, everyone became silent. The lie detector did not sound any alarm, which meant that everything was true.

Hannes and Bennett opened their eyes wide in disbelief.

This was not the plan of the Godora Civilization?

Was it just because … it was interesting?

"Impossible!" Hannes lost his composure. "You are just an ordinary person. If Godora did not interfere, how could two ordinary people do such a thing?"

Kedan shrunk his head and said softly, "Actually, it is quite simple. No one suspected that the emissary was fake … because we are really Godora people."

Hannes was stunned. He had thought that two ordinary people would not be able to cause a war to break out on Blue Star, but at this moment, he was speechless.

That's right, they were all Godora people.

That was enough …

Because Godora's civilization was advanced, Godora's people were also "advanced". Who would suspect that?

Bennett's face was ice cold as he grabbed Kedan by the collar. Countless people from Blue Star had died because of the war, and the reason was that this Godora person in front of him thought that it was fun. However, looking at Kedan's panicked but not guilty expression, Bennett swallowed the words that were about to come out of his mouth.

At that time, in the eyes of this Godora, the Blue Star Civilization was like an ant's nest … How could playing with ants be a sin?

Han Xiao had a strange expression on his face. He felt that it was ridiculous.

He had thought that the internal strife of Blue Star was because there was an organization plotting in the dark, but the truth was out of his expectations. There was no organization plotting against the weak Blue Star Civilization at that time. The real reason was that an audacious outsider suddenly had a wicked idea. There was no conspiracy, no trickery, it was that simple.

A small Godora person was bored and started a war for fun. After watching the show, he pretended that nothing had happened. In the end, due to the convenience of his position and the fact that Godora Civilization did not value Blue Star, this matter was kept secret for decades.

As for Angele, he was a loser who could not survive in his own society. He purposely bullied the weak and stirred up trouble. He saw it as a form of entertainment, looking for a sense of superiority on an aboriginal planet.

The two of them relied on their golden skin.

The matter was that simple. It was extremely absurd, but it was so real that it was tragic.

Because they were weak, they were reduced to playthings.

This made Han Xiao feel like a woman from a good family being molested by a little brat who relied on his family's power and influence, unable to resist.

To the Blue Star Civilization, this was like an unexpected disaster, an unexpected disaster.

Although he did not have any special feelings for Blue Star — he was not someone who would be affected by emotions — at this time, he was indeed a little angry. It was not toward Godora. In this matter, perhaps the crime of Godora Civilization was that they were too strong, so strong that their citizens were too superior.

"This is … ridiculous." Han Xiao let out a breath of turbid air. His mood was complicated.

Even when the interface showed that the hidden Grade A mission had been completed, he was not in the mood to check it immediately.

The Sky Ring mercenaries left, but Kedan was left behind. After knocking him out, he was locked in a cage. Han Xiao handed him over to Bennett.

Hannes and Bennett found it hard to accept this fact. The changes of Blue Star over the past few decades, in the face of this ridiculous reason, all of the suffering seemed to have become meaningless. An entire civilization was being toyed with by two aliens. It was like a joke.

This planet could have been a better place …

"Since things have already come to this, don't think too much. If this is the truth, you have to believe it even if you don't want to." Han Xiao shook his head.

Bennett lowered his head and thought about something. Suddenly, he stood up and looked at Han Xiao seriously.

"When you were negotiating with the Six Nations, I did not interrupt, but I thought that you were ambitious at that time. Although I did not say anything, I did hold a grudge against you … but I was wrong."

Bennett clenched his fists. "Only now do I understand your good intentions. Being weak is a sin. You went to the universe not only to deal with the disaster but also to fight for a future for Blue Star. You are greater than me!"

Han Xiao's mouth twitched. Since when did he have such thoughts?

Could it be that the higher the Favorability, the stronger the imagination?

"If not for you, this planet would have been kept in the dark forever. I thank you on behalf of the entire Blue Star." Bennett bowed deeply and did not get up. Hearing this, Hannes stood up and bowed as well.

"Don't be like this … you guys are making me feel like I'm a good person." Han Xiao had a helpless expression. Everything he did was for the sake of profit. It was just that his actions that extended from profit had led to some good results.

However, he had never thought of himself as a good person. Just like now, he had already started to think about how to use Kedan's value.

…

At the same time, in Black Phantom Sanctuary.

The players came and went, and they were still active in the front lines of the disaster relief. In the arena not far from the square, the Black Star Mercenaries started a new round of selections. The sounds of fighting and shouting could be heard from afar. Many of the refugees who had been injected with the suppressants had hope for life again. Although they were in the midst of a disaster, the Sanctuary was brimming with vitality.

In the sky, a few Godora Disaster Relief Team spaceships were floating. Nagojin looked through the porthole at the arena below and thought about something.

His adjutant stood at the side and observed his expression. "Your Excellency Nagojin, what do you think of these Inhumans?"

"They have great potential." Nagojin nodded slowly. After these few days of observation, he had deeply felt the potential of the players. He had paid a little attention to them at the beginning, but now, he paid a lot of attention to them.

With the unexpected surprise of the Inhumans, Nagojin felt that the goal of this trip was no longer just disaster relief.

Although they were helping Blue Star with the disaster relief, it did not mean that Godora cared much about a low-level civilization. It was just the influence of public opinion and their identity. However, in Nagojin's eyes, the Inhumans seemed to be able to bring them greater benefits.

"There are a lot of Inhumans. There are about a million of them in the entire Blue Star. With so many Supers and the potential to grow, they are a force to be reckoned with no matter where they are," the adjutant said.

"That's right. Maybe we should have a deeper interaction with the Inhumans. They are worth roping in."

"What do you want to do?"

"… Send out a recruitment notice to them. Just like Black Star, our Godora should be more competitive than a mercenary group."

Nagakin made a decision. He respected Black Star's strength, but with such a large amount of Super resources in front of him, for the benefit of the civilization, he could not sit back and do nothing. He also wanted a share of the pie.
